# CorporateGuild - Comprehensive LLM Context & Platform Specification

> Full machine-readable knowledge base for CorporateGuild (https://corporateguild.com), India's premier tech job aggregation and career advisory platform.

## Architecture Overview

CorporateGuild operates an active-active dual-node cluster deployed on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI):
- **Gateway Node (VM 1)**: `129.154.43.222` (Primary reverse proxy with Caddy 2, state mutation, master SQLite database, and automated OCI Object Storage backups).
- **Worker Node (VM 2)**: `129.225.92.91` (Active-active application worker, high-throughput search engine, synchronized SQLite snapshot, and Redis read replica).
- **Database**: SQLite 3 with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and synchronous=NORMAL for concurrent non-blocking reads and point-in-time streaming replication.
- **Cache**: Redis 7 storing job hashes, role index sets, and session caches for sub-20ms search queries.

## Platform Integrity Standards

- **Direct ATS Sourcing Only**: Jobs are fetched directly from authorized employer ATS API endpoints (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, BambooHR, SmartRecruiters, Pinpoint, Comeet, Jobvite, Rippling, Recruitee, Workable, Breezy HR, Oracle Cloud).
- **No Third-Party Scraping**: No scraping of job boards, aggregators, or third-party recruiters.
- **Strict Location Hygiene**: Only jobs with verified Indian locations (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Kolkata, etc.) or explicitly marked Remote within India are retained.
- **Duplicate De-duplication**: MD5 hash-based fingerprinting across company, normalized title, location, and apply URL ensures 0 duplicate entries.
